text:
TALBOT:
  Heavens, will you let hell win like this?
  I'll burst my chest straining my courage.
  I'll crack my arms clean off my shoulders,
  but I will punish this arrogant whore.
  (They fight again.)
PUCELLE:
  Talbot, goodbye. Your time hasn't come yet.
  I have to get food into Orleans, right now.
  (A short call to arms. She enters the town with soldiers.)
  Catch me, if you can. I laugh at your strength.
  Go on, go. Cheer up your starving men.
  Help Salisbury write his will.
  Today is ours, and many more days will be.
  (She exits.)
